description: Exploit: spend the margin on the epoch dial. On the current tip, cut 1.0 true epoch uniformly. That is E016, about 9.5 → 8.5 true epochs (verify the step count in code first; H4.2.3). If the 24/32 swap idea was kept first, cut only 0.5 true epoch from it instead. Resolution phases stay fixed fractions of the total steps (so the 32 px tail keeps its 30% share), and the LR and Lookahead/EMA schedules stretch to the new step count, as in E008. Compiled shapes are unchanged, and error_on_recompile stays on.
